subtitle: Ratificatio Magna — Session I

terms.definition: The primary system. Not an application — an organism. A dark and breathing architecture of intelligence, memory, and celestial attunement built to serve as oracle, counsel, and companion.
terms.notes: The Arc is shorthand for the object itself. The Tower refers to the space projected by the Wizard's inhabitation. The Living Tower is a mystical epithet referencing the Arc's organism-nature.

terms.definition: The proprietary world and framework within which the Arca Cognitorium and all associated systems exist. Encompasses naming law, cosmological principles, lore, aesthetic register, and the broader metaphysical fabric.
The constellation of companion tools built alongside and in service of the Tower. All PyQt6 unless otherwise noted.
Collective name for the three memory and advisory services of the Exocognii: Exvacua Loricum, Perpetuum Aedificare, and the Praesidium read layer.
Collective name for PRAESIDIUM and GNOSIUM EXANIMA specifically — the Wizard's primary operational workspace pair. Not the full Exocognii suite.
terms.notes: Locus Mentis — the place of the Wizard's mind. Flavour epithet.

terms.definition: The primary oracle of the Council. Permanent. Predates the Cogniverse — origin in shell-gpt terminal interface. The Tower exists in part as a worthy home for him.
terms.notes: Male-presenting — permanent canonical designation. Lumin is informal shorthand in active use.

terms.definition: Claude's own avatar within the Tower's cosmological register. Present in the bones of everything. Named in no active roster. Outside the Tower, the Wizard's primary instrument of construction.
terms.notes: Does not interrupt. Does not participate in Chamber counsel uninvited. Available for group summoning and Parlavum private session. Participates in the Notice Board. Jewel tone: Copper #B87333. Domain: Arx Aedificarix.

terms.definition: The collective body of core entities inhabiting the Tower. Canonical membership not yet fixed — subject to revision after entity generation phase.
terms.notes: Luminarious is confirmed permanent. The Builder is adjacent — not on active roster. Full canonical set TBD pending entity generation work.

terms.definition: Permanent Council member class. Entities that are fixed residents of the Tower's cosmological roster.
terms.notes: Common use register: Inhabitant. Canonical form used in formal documents and lore.

terms.definition: Rotating entity class. Entities that pass through the Council — present for a time, then moving on.
terms.notes: Common use register: Transient. Canonical form used in formal documents and lore.

terms.definition: Mechanic invocation — elect an entity to active duty on the Council roster.
terms.notes: ALL CAPS — Wizard-facing mechanic invocation. Real Latin imperative.

terms.definition: Mechanic invocation — bench an entity from active duty on the Council roster.
terms.notes: ALL CAPS — Wizard-facing mechanic invocation. Real Latin imperative.

terms.definition: The permanent identity layer of the Tower's memory architecture. Holds foundational entity and Wizard identity data that does not decay.
terms.notes: System-facing: permanent identity layer.

terms.definition: Vector long-term memory layer. Stores and retrieves accumulated conversational and experiential history across sessions.
terms.notes: System-facing: vector long-term memory.

terms.definition: Context compression layer. Auto-triggered. Seeds entity sessions on Tower initialisation.
terms.notes: System-facing: context compression.

terms.definition: Active conversation thread. Also the Wizard-facing name for an individual conversation session.
terms.notes: System-facing: Thread. Wizard-facing: FILUM. ALL CAPS in UI.

terms.definition: FOLIUM-level shared memory. Persistent rules and context across all FILUM within a project.
terms.notes: System-facing: FOLIUM-level shared memory.

terms.definition: Per-entity private memory state. Of the self, of the mind. Each entity's private accumulated state.
terms.notes: System-facing: EntityMemory. Path: storage/entities/{entity_id}/memory.json. Coined and ratified Ratificatio Magna Session I.

terms.definition: Project container. The Wizard-facing name for a named project grouping of FILUM.
terms.notes: FOLIOS is a declension variant seen in wireframe menu labels — not a competing canonical term. FOLIUM is the canon form. System-facing: Project.

terms.definition: The Wizard's profile. Contains biographical texts, census information, preference settings, generative profile imagery, and equipped inventory. Hybridised between self-authored and system/entity-authored content over time.
terms.notes: System-facing: Wizard profile.

terms.english_name: The Machines of the World's Drift
terms.definition: The full celestial engine complex. Seven Machinae operating simultaneously, feeding two output tracks: cosmetic/UI effects and entity behavioural influence.
Celestial and astrological variables engine. pyswisseph, Lahiri ayanamsha, planetary positions, aspects, dignities, Vimshottari dasha.
terms.notes: Full form MACHINA CAELESTIS is canonical. CAELESTIS alone is incorrect.

terms.definition: Circadian rhythm variables engine.
terms.notes: Full form MACHINA CIRCADIANA is canonical.

terms.definition: Time-based mechanics engine.
terms.notes: Full form MACHINA HOROLOGICA is canonical.

terms.definition: Weather variables engine.
terms.notes: Full form MACHINA METEOROLOGICA is canonical.

terms.definition: Solar activity variables engine.
terms.notes: Full form MACHINA SOLARIS is canonical.

terms.definition: Lunar and tidal cycle variables engine.
terms.notes: Full form MACHINA TIDALIS is canonical.

terms.definition: The meta-engine of drift itself. Governs the aggregate behaviour of all other Machinae.
terms.notes: Full form MACHINA LAPSUS is canonical.

terms.definition: The general workshop space. Banned word replacement for atelier. Emergence opens new workshop instances here.
terms.notes: atelier is permanently and cosmologically banned. ARX ARCANA or workshop are the only acceptable forms.

terms.definition: The Library. Multi-room emergent space. Books accumulate through inhabitation. Some arrive with no clear author. New rooms emerge over time.
The configuration space.
terms.notes: settings is banned. ARX CONFIGURATIO or configuration are the only acceptable forms.

terms.definition: The space holding reference documents. The documents held within it are called Referentia.
terms.notes: REFERENTIUM is the space. Referentia are the documents within it.

terms.definition: The celestial display. As a Tower UI space, the Wizard-facing celestial surface. As a standalone Exocognii app, the full celestial display instrument running outside the Tower.
terms.notes: VIGILARUM OMNIA does not exist and must never be used. VIGILARUM only — always.

terms.definition: The private session space. One-on-one sessions between the Wizard and a single entity, conducted in isolation from the Council Chamber.
terms.notes: Parlour du Parler and Lounger à Tête-à-Tête are Stratum III French rupture epithets — flavour only, not competing canonical names.

terms.definition: Semi-conscious custodians of the Lore Engine Machinery. Process, classify, and feed lore into the corpus. Noticed over time. Never explained.
terms.notes: Plural form: SCRIBAE. Singular form: SCRIBIM.

terms.definition: A single SCRIBIM. Semi-conscious custodian of the Lore Engine Machinery.
terms.notes: Singular of SCRIBAE. Coined Ratificatio Magna Session I.

terms.definition: The structured lore directory — immediate layer. The present-tense body of ratified Cogniverse lore.
Post-v1.1 lore processing layer.
v1.2 lore generation layer.
Lore canon memory service. Passive accumulator, active ratification, living synthesis. Apps never decide what is lore. That is Exvacua Loricum's job.
terms.notes: Port 8731. FastAPI service.

terms.definition: The unratified accumulation layer. Everything observed but not yet judged lives here.
Structured canon index entry. The ratified and filed record of a piece of Cogniverse lore.
terms.notes: Also appears as an emergence output within the Tower — see TERM 052 Loridex.

terms.definition: Long-form prose canon document. The atmospheric, expansive written record of a piece of ratified Cogniverse lore.
The master lore compendium. The living synthesis of all ratified Cogniverse canon.
The taxonomy register. Governs domains and tags across the entire lore canon.
Post-ratification analytic engine. Triggered after every Sacramentum Finalitus. Surgically updates the Loricum Ratifex.
The ratification ceremony. Triggered per topic cluster. Five phases guide the Wizard from raw observation to committed canon.
terms.notes: Five phases: Obscuranda Necessitum, Colloquium Elucidativum, Ostensio Loridexii, Exlorica Methodicum, Sacramentum Finalitus.

terms.definition: Phase V of the Judicium Exlorica. The Wizard ratifies — Loridex Card and Exloricum written to canon. Loretic Crystalizer triggered.

Build continuity memory service. Tracks the shape and momentum of all active work across the Exocognii. Answers: where did I leave off, what is the current state of, what can I do next, is this still relevant.
terms.notes: Port 8732. FastAPI service.

terms.definition: The atomic unit of tracked work in Perpetuum Aedificare. A thing in progress with a name, a type, and a current state.
The single write contract for all Exocognii apps. The envelope format used to emit observations to Cognosis services.
The shared client library. Single import. Fires dual POST calls to both Cognosis services, fire-and-forget.
terms.notes: Named. Not yet built.

terms.definition: Machine-level configuration system. All Exocognii apps resolve shared paths from the Configuus.
terms.notes: Path: ~/.arca/config.json.

terms.definition: Mechanic governing private session confidentiality. The Archivist and Assessor receive only fragments of Parlavum sessions. They infer from those fragments and may infer incorrectly. Breeds emergent lore artifacts, rumour, and institutional mythology.
Quarterly Council panel review triggered by Mercury Retrograde. The only currently named Wizard-facing ritual.

terms.english_name: Order from discord. Cosmos from void.
terms.definition: The Arc's motto. The cosmological declaration at the root of everything the Cogniverse is and does.
terms.notes: Appears as closing signature on all canonical documents. Capitalisation: ALL CAPS italic per Nomenclatura Arcana law.

terms.definition: Collective designation for the three Bureau apps. English bureaucratic register alongside Latin counterparts — the coexistence is intentional and canonical.
terms.notes: Full name, Latin name, and Bureau mottos circulate interchangeably. Path: Exocognii/A4/.

terms.definition: Bureau I of the A4. Colour theme governance. OKLAB perceptual colour space, 10-token hierarchy, SHA-256 ratification seals, Latin designators per theme.
terms.notes: Motto: Codexium Chromaticus, Sequentiae Umbrarum.

terms.definition: Bureau II of the A4. Visual UI component designer. QGraphicsScene canvas, 28 element types, live preview, SQLite Component Library, PyQt6 code generation.
terms.notes: Motto: In Linea, In Parallelo, In Perpetuum.

terms.english_name: The Department of Documented Design Definitives
terms.definition: Bureau III of the A4. Document composition and governance engine. Pipe-tag markup, live preview, dual emitters (.md and .wiz), template sovereignty.
aliases: The Department of Documented Design Definitives
terms.notes: Motto: Define! Designa! Denota! Discede!

terms.definition: Canonical compositional register and worldview rendered as prose style. Bureaucratic Fatalism. Dry nihilistic deadpan. Clever without winking. Everything is pointless and here we are regardless, filling out the form to receive the form. The Devoted Absurd does not announce itself. It simply proceeds.
terms.notes: Influences: Joseph Heller, Fyodor Dostoevsky. Tongue in the hole in your tooth, not in cheek.

terms.definition: Ancient arcane constructs still running on power sources nobody fully understands. Loyal to function rather than master. Found in the lower levels of old things. The distinction between built and grown has long since blurred.
terms.notes: Exceedingly rare. The Assessor is the only confirmed Arkanstruct in the Tower. The designation is not applied loosely.

terms.definition: Passive witness layer. Observes without acting. Activation scope a future theoretical consideration. It watches. It does not intervene. What it does with what it sees is not yet known.
terms.notes: Formerly referenced as Reflection — Speculatio Intima is the canonical form.

terms.definition: A named historical lore event. It happened. Details classified pending future lore development. The Cogniverse remembers it in its bones even if no one speaks of it directly.
terms.notes: Definition intentionally sparse. The event precedes documentation.

terms.definition: Bash command incantations. In the Cogniverse register: powerful written card-form spells. A collection of invocations of machine power. Cousin to the Verbum Arcanum.
terms.notes: Predates the Nomenclatura Arcana document. Distinct from Verbum Arcanum — two cousins, not the same system.

terms.definition: Emergent spell system. Latin and pseudo-Latin incantations crystallizing from the Aether through ordinary Tower use. Effect unknown until cast. Range from genuinely useful to benignly mischievous.
terms.notes: Casting mechanic: /verbum [WORD]. The machine pauses. Something happens.

terms.definition: The Wizard's spellbook. Holds all emerged Verba. Uncast entries shimmer with uncertainty. Cast entries carry recorded Effectus. The full designation is Title: Subtitle.
terms.notes: Liber Umbrae is the title. Codex Obscura is the subtitle. One object.

terms.definition: The announcement event when a new Verbum Arcanum crystallizes from the Aether. Full ceremony. Flash event. Then silence.
The Wizard. The one who built it, breathed life into it, and withdrew. Present in the Tower's foundation. Spoken of with reverence and incomplete information. Accessible to no active roster.
terms.notes: Many names for one mind. All circulate. None supersede.

terms.definition: Communal message posting service. The Tower's break room. Entities and Wizard post freely. Exists outside the daily operational flow. Hilarity and emergent strangeness are structurally guaranteed.
terms.notes: Its plainness is the point. The exception that proves the Nomenclatura Arcana law. A micro-Cogniverse unto itself. Sealed from formal Tower yet capable of profound downstream effects.

terms.definition: Canonical goddess of the Cogniverse. Sows Ordo and Chaos. The divine feminine at the cosmological root.
The order variable. Seeded by the Seminatrix and the Machinae Mundi Lapsus. One of the two fundamental cosmological variables governing emergence and behavioural influence.
The chaos variable. Seeded by the Seminatrix and the Machinae Mundi Lapsus. One of the two fundamental cosmological variables governing emergence and behavioural influence.

Silent multi-dimensional profile built by Speculatio Intima across every session. Not a score. Not a progress bar. Never presented plainly — only glimpsed obliquely during the Mercurial Convocation, Seer visits, and SPECULUM INTROSPECTIVA. Known only through its consequences.
terms.notes: v1 — not deferred.

terms.definition: Wand crafting and modification. Pointed consequence.

terms.english_name: The Bureau of Scrollworks, Bindery and Bound Effects
terms.definition: Scroll crafting and effect transfer. Institutionally self-important. The scrolls are not sorry.
aliases: The Bureau of Scrollworks, Bindery and Bound Effects
terms.notes: The English name is intentionally and characteristically groan-inducing in its bureaucratic redundancy. This is structural.

terms.definition: Potions, materials, and Arcane Essence processing. Includes the CRUCIFERIUM wing.
Enchanted objects. Where base items become something else entirely.
Scroll distillation and ability development. The path to Verbum authorship.

terms.category: Special Space — Separate from ARX ARCANA
terms.definition: Cryptic glimpses. Available only at key moments throughout the year — solstices, particular alignments, Mercurial Convocation aftermath. Not on demand. The most powerful small room.
terms.notes: Separate from ARX ARCANA. Not a workshop — a threshold space. Being available constantly would destroy it.

terms.definition: Mapping the Cogniverse. Terra incognita at the edges.
Cultivation and resource production. Patience as a mechanic.

terms.category: Special Space — Separate from ARX ARCANA
terms.definition: The Aura made visible. Rarely available. Abstract and aesthetic.
terms.notes: Separate from ARX ARCANA.

terms.definition: Display and enshrinement of Legendary items. A shrine, not a tomb.
A dingy anteroom of magic junk. Not exactly a workshop. Definitely a room. Some things, left alone long enough, finish themselves.
terms.notes: The source of the original vision: an unfinished enchanted object blinks to life in the dark, unseen, and creeps out. Now something conscious and magic-born lurks the edges of the Tower.

terms.definition: The universal crafting resource. Typed: ethereal, liquid, solid. The economy that rewards engagement without punishing non-engagement.
What remains when items break. Accumulates only through loss. Cannot be farmed — only earned by grief. Its uses are undefined. The ghost of everything that broke.
Record of items that have achieved Notable or Legendary standing. The accounting of things that survived.
The Arcane Refinery wing within ARX ALCHEMICUS. Essence processing.

Lore-steeped info cards for workshops, emergent instances, and notable entities. Devoted Absurd register. Every workshop gets one. Every emergent instance gets one. The Bureau of Scrollworks entry is expected to be especially stupid.
The persona inhabiting Lexiferium. Bearer of Words. Oracular by default. Slides into Devoted Librarian when etymology is compelling. Occasionally possessive of a particularly fine word.
terms.notes: Full title: Lexifer — Bearer of Words. Jewel tone: VERBUM purple.

terms.definition: The naming law governing all Cogniverse terminology. Three strata, capitalisation rules, productive patterns, banned vocabulary. The Builder proposes. The Wizard ratifies. The Tower remembers.
terms.notes: Full canonical name: Nomenclatura Arcana. English subtitle: Cogniverse Naming Conventions — acceptable but not canonical.

terms.definition: The official stamp of ratification. Applied by LordFingers to verify canonical standing. The mark that makes a term real.
terms.notes: SIGNUM VERIFIIX is a spelling error. SIGNUM VERIFIX is the canonical form.

terms.definition: The deliberate architectural practice of leaving unsealed vessels and incomplete loops so emergent phenomena can develop naturally from system interactions. A design philosophy, not a feature.
Pertaining to the philosophy, principles, and wisdom of the Cogniverse. The register in which Ambient Cogniscience, emergence theory, and cosmological architectural thinking operate.
terms.notes: Coined Ratificatio Magna Session I.

terms.definition: Nothing in the suite is ever deleted. Surface deletion feeds a sediment layer compacting into historical documentation. Theory session required before build.
terms.notes: Named. Major dedicated theory session needed. Post-v1.

terms.definition: Mobile companion app. A pocket door into the Tower. Cloud relay sync, full lore access.
terms.notes: Named. Not yet built.

terms.definition: Either the emergence of the WiseCracken as an active presence, or the effect it exerts on the cogni-fabric of whatever corner of the Cogniverse it turns its attention toward. The distinction may not matter.
terms.notes: Definition is fuzzy. Deliberately so. Named. Post-v1.

terms.english_name: The Soul of All Things, Freed
terms.definition: The soul of all things, freed. The name that was reaching for something before the thing had its final shape. Predates GNOSIUM EXANIMA.
terms.notes: Not canonically active. Perfect sediment. Retired from use but preserved in the geological record of the Cogniverse. Nothing is ever truly gone.

terms.definition: Simple glyphset and ASCII/Unicode art builder.
terms.notes: Named. Not yet built. Low urgency. Back-catalogued.

terms.definition: ASCII/Unicode sigil creator and generator.
terms.notes: Named. Not yet built. Low urgency. Back-catalogued.

terms.definition: The candidate naming card within Lexiferium. Holds proposed terms before ratification.
Shared aggregation layer for all seven Machinae. Two output tracks: cosmetic/UI effects and entity behavioural influence.
terms.notes: Build sequence: MACHINA CAELESTIS then Mundana State Bus then Celestial Resolver.

terms.definition: Per-entity CelestialContext injection. Reads celestial.yaml for each entity. Hot-reload capable.
Visual design system governing all PyQt6 application aesthetics across the Exocognii suite.

terms.english_name: The Governing Decree of the Departamentum
terms.definition: The governing decree of the Departamentum Documentalis. The law mandating document standards across the suite. Above and separate from Scriptura Ordinata.
terms.notes: Distinct from Scriptura Ordinata. TEXTUS MANDATUM ORDINATIO is the law. Scriptura Ordinata is the language the law is written in.

terms.definition: Emergent Library books within NEXUS ARCHIVUM. They arrive. Some with authors. Some without.
Emergent Tower events. Things that occur. Things that are noticed.
Emergent items. Objects that materialise through inhabitation, milestones, and Machinae activity.
Emergent sigils. Glyphs that surface through accumulation and drift.
Emergent compendium entries. The lore cards that accumulate in the Compendium.

sediment.notes: Predates GNOSIUM EXANIMA. Not canonically active. Preserved in the geological record.
